entities.summary: Giulia Valle, SCSJA was an Italian Catholic nun and a professed member of the Sisters of Charity of Saint Joan Antida Thouret. She assumed the religious name of Nemesia. Following her profession, she became an educator in Turin and the surrounding areas and was known for her careful attention to people's individual educational needs.
